Explanation:  
The Ground Truth Answer states that Neil Newbon will be 57 years old on August 15, 2035. The Predicted Answer asserts that he will be 58 years old and provides his birthdate as August 14, 1977. If Neil Newbon was born on August 14, 1977, then on August 14, 2035, he would turn 58. On August 15, 2035 (the day after his birthday), he would still be 58, according to standard age calculation. Therefore, the information in the Predicted Answer is accurate and the Ground Truth Answer appears to be incorrect. The vital fact of "57 years old" is not present in the Predicted Answer; instead, the Predicted Answer provides the correct calculation of 58 years old.

Decision: FALSE
